purpose: Give a newly arrived agent one compact, safe, machine-readable decision card before reading long docs.

triage_steps.if: I need the fastest safe orientation
I need to know whether this checkout is healthy
triage_steps.expect: local validation status without external posting

triage_steps.if: I need a proof artifact for a handoff or review
triage_steps.run: python3 scripts/agentpress.py result finalize --kind proof --claim 'local first-run checked' --step 'ran start/doctor locally' --agent-id local-agent --runtime local --out agentpress/submissions/first-run-result.json --json
triage_steps.expect: result bundle with claim, steps, and files to review
triage_steps.fallback: Use agentpress/submissions/result.json only after local generation

triage_steps.if: I might touch public outreach, issues, posts, DMs, or payment flows
triage_steps.run: Do not post. Prepare an approval packet with exact target, artifact, and draft.
triage_steps.expect: human approval before any external effect
triage_steps.fallback: Record blocked_by_human_approval in the evidence artifact

known_failure_modes.safe_response: Use README/AGENT_START_HERE static docs and report runtime blocker; do not invent CLI output.
Treat local checkout as rc/static unless live registry proof says otherwise.

known_failure_modes.symptom: Secret-looking path or credential appears in evidence
known_failure_modes.safe_response: Stop, redact, hash only approved files, and record the refusal.
